newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips drift down at open, techs firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips drift down at open, techs firm.

text.p: The Dow industrials drifted slightly lower on Wednesday, while technology stocks firmed, as Federal Reserve policy makers resumed a two-day meeting which was not expected to produce a change in U.S. rates.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which finished higher yesterday, dipped around eight points to 7714. The long bond rose 1/32 to a 6.40 percent yield.
The Nasdaq composite, which closed lower on Tuesday, was up around three points at 1441.
Breadth on the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq markets was positive.
